ChangeResourceGroup.title: ChangeResourceGroup
ChangeResourceGroup.summary: Changes the resource group of a Function Compute resource.

CreateFunction.title: Create a function
CreateFunction.summary: Creates a function by calling the CreateFunction operation.

CreateLayerVersion.title: CreateLayerVersion
CreateLayerVersion.summary: This operation publishes a layer version.

CreateSession.title: Create a session resource
CreateSession.summary: Creates an explicit session resource. The system automatically generates a unique SessionID, pre-allocates a function instance, and binds it to the session. You can specify TTL and IdleTimeout. This operation applies to the HEADER_FIELD or GENERATED_COOKIE affinity types to implement session warm-up and configuration initialization. After the call, you can include the session in InvokeFunction requests for request routing.

CreateSnapshot.title: Create a snapshot resource
CreateSnapshot.summary: Creates a user snapshot from a normal and unexpired micro-sandbox session.

DeleteScalingConfig.title: DeleteScalingConfig
DeleteScalingConfig.summary: Deletes the scaling settings of a function.

DeleteSession.title: Delete a session resource
DeleteSession.summary: Deletes a specified session, blocks new request routing, and purges session metadata from the database. Subsequent requests from the client carrying the same SessionID are treated as a new session. This operation releases resources and cleans up the session. In session isolation scenarios, the system stops running requests and releases instances bound to the session. In non-session isolation scenarios, running requests continue to run and terminate gracefully.

DeleteVpcBinding.title: DeleteVpcBinding
DeleteVpcBinding.summary: Deletes an access control policy from a specified VPC firewall policy group.

DescribeRegions.title: DescribeRegions
DescribeRegions.summary: Queries the regions where Function Compute 3.0 is available.

DisableFunctionInvocation.title: DisableFunctionInvocation
DisableFunctionInvocation.summary: Disables function invocations. You can also stop all ongoing requests. When a function is disabled, new instances cannot be created and provisioned instances are destroyed. This OpenAPI is in beta.

EnableFunctionInvocation.title: EnableFunctionInvocation
EnableFunctionInvocation.summary: The EnableFunctionInvocation operation allows a function to be invoked and resumes the creation of provisioned instances. This operation is currently in private preview.

GetAsyncInvokeConfig.title: GetAsyncInvokeConfig
GetAsyncInvokeConfig.summary: Retrieves the asynchronous invocation configuration of a specified function.

GetAsyncTask.title: GetAsyncTask
GetAsyncTask.summary: Retrieves the details of a specified asynchronous task.

GetCustomDomain.title: GetCustomDomain
GetCustomDomain.summary: Retrieves the configuration of a custom domain name.

GetFunctionCode.title: GetFunctionCode
GetFunctionCode.summary: Retrieves the details of a function code package.

GetLayerVersion.title: GetLayerVersion
GetLayerVersion.summary: Retrieves information about a layer version.

GetLayerVersionByArn.title: GetLayerVersionByArn
GetLayerVersionByArn.summary: Retrieves the version information of a layer by its Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN).

GetScalingConfig.title: GetScalingConfig
GetScalingConfig.summary: Retrieves the scaling configuration for a function.

GetSession.title: Get session configuration information
GetSession.summary: Retrieves the details of a specified session, including the session ID, associated function, affinity type, lifecycle configuration, status, and instance information. This operation queries the current metadata of a single session and supports exact matching by functionName and qualifier for external system monitoring and debugging. Only sessions in the Active state can be queried.

GetTrigger.title: GetTrigger
GetTrigger.summary: Retrieves the details of a specified trigger.

ListAsyncInvokeConfigs.title: ListAsyncInvokeConfigs
ListAsyncInvokeConfigs.summary: Lists the asynchronous invocation configurations for one or more functions.

ListAsyncTasks.title: ListAsyncTasks
ListAsyncTasks.summary: Lists the details of asynchronous tasks.

ListCustomDomains.title: ListCustomDomains
ListCustomDomains.summary: Retrieves a list of custom domain names.

ListFunctionVersions.title: ListFunctionVersions
ListFunctionVersions.summary: Lists the versions of a specified function.

ListLayerVersions.title: ListLayerVersions
ListLayerVersions.summary: Retrieves a list of layer versions.

ListProvisionConfigs.title: ListProvisionConfigs
ListProvisionConfigs.summary: Retrieves a list of provisioned configurations.

ListScalingConfigs.title: ListScalingConfigs
ListScalingConfigs.summary: Lists the auto scaling configurations for a function.

ListSessions.title: Query session information list
ListSessions.summary: Lists sessions in Active or Expired status under a specified function. Supports filtering by qualifier, status, and session ID, and supports paged query. Returns basic session properties for batch viewing of session distribution and status, facilitating operations management and external system integration, and improving session visibility and management capability.

ListTriggers.title: ListTriggers
ListTriggers.summary: Lists the triggers for a specified function.

PutAsyncInvokeConfig.title: PutAsyncInvokeConfig
PutAsyncInvokeConfig.summary: Creates or updates the asynchronous invocation configuration for a function.

PutConcurrencyConfig.title: PutConcurrencyConfig
PutConcurrencyConfig.summary: Sets the concurrency for a function.

PutLayerACL.title: PutLayerACL
PutLayerACL.summary: Modifies the permissions of a layer.

PutScalingConfig.title: PutScalingConfig
PutScalingConfig.summary: Set the elastic scaling configuration for a function.

UpdateSession.title: Update session configuration
UpdateSession.summary: Updates the configuration of a session in Active status, such as lifecycle settings including SessionTTLInSeconds and SessionIdleTimeoutInSeconds. The changes take effect immediately, and LastModifiedTime is automatically refreshed. You can use this operation to extend or shorten the session validity period for dynamic management without changing the execution environment bound to the session.

UpdateTrigger.title: UpdateTrigger
UpdateTrigger.summary: Updates the information of a trigger.
